import ProofLab.Bridge

set_option maxHeartbeats 300000
theorem prooflab_result (α : Type) [PartialOrder α] (a b c : α) (ab : a ≤ b) (bc : b ≤ c) (ca : c ≤ a) : a = c := by
  apply le_antisymm
  apply le_trans
  assumption
  assumption
  assumption

#prooflab_audit prooflab_result
